news.contents: Baltimore Ravens head coach Jesse Minter said on Tuesday that the team will know more about when quarterback Lamar Jackson (thumb) will have right-thumb surgery within the next couple of days, according to Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic. Meanwhile, Tyler Huntley (toe) is a candidate to join Jackson on Injured Reserve, which would require him to miss at least the next four games. Jackson, who has already missed time this year with a high-ankle sprain, is expected to miss the rest of the 2026 ...

news.analysis: Coleman led the Broncos' running backs in carries for the second straight game. More importantly, he out-touched J.K. Dobbins 15-7 and scored the game-winning touchdown with two minutes remaining. Coleman also had a 51-yard reception on the final touchdown drive. So, what does the Broncos' backfield look like after two games with Coleman back? He has 24 carries compared to 13 for Dobbins. Coleman has entered the weekly starter fantasy conversation.
